general.changesApplyImmediately: Changes on this tab apply immediately.
general.descSound: Play a system beep sound when workflows complete, exports finish, or other important events occur.
general.descUpdates: Check for and download desktop app updates from the selected release channel.
general.descConfirmManyNodes: Running a workflow executes every node at once. Show a confirmation when a run would launch many model/provider nodes that could overload an API.
general.descManyNodesThreshold: Warn when a run would execute more than this many model/provider nodes (LLM, image, audio, API, etc.).
general.descAudioBuffer: Playback buffer for realtime audio (modular synth patches). Lower values reduce knob-to-ear latency; higher values prevent dropouts when the editor is busy.
general.descMaxParallelRuns: Maximum number of workflow runs you can execute at once. Additional runs queue and start automatically as running ones finish.
general.descMaxRunsPerWorkflow: How many runs of the same workflow may run at once before further runs queue. Applies to concurrent generation (timeline, sketch); canvas runs always stay sequential.
general.descSnapToGrid: Align nodes to the canvas grid while dragging. Also in the View menu of the desktop app.
general.descGridSize: Grid size used when Snap to grid is on. The canvas grid is drawn every 25 units.
general.descAutosave: Automatically save your workflow at regular intervals.
general.descAutosaveInterval: How often to automatically save your workflow.
general.descCheckpoint: Create a checkpoint version before executing workflow.
general.descAutosaveOnClose: Automatically save when closing the tab or window.
general.descUpdateChannel: Stable follows full releases. Nightly follows prerelease nightly builds. Nightly builds default to the Nightly channel.
general.descMarkNodesAsSelectedAfter: Mark nodes as selected after changing a node's position. If disabled, nodes can still be selected by clicking on them.
general.descWhatHappensWhenYouClose: What happens when you close the main window. Ask every time shows a dialog with options, Quit application closes the app completely, and Keep running in background keeps it running in the system tray.
general.descDarkOrLightColorsFor: Dark or light colors for the whole app. The sun and moon button in the sidebar switches it too.
general.descSizeOfTextAcrossThe: Size of text across the whole app, including menus and nodes.
general.descDrawTheExactFrameFor: Draw the exact frame for the playhead in the timeline preview. Clips that WebCodecs cannot decode keep using the browser video player.
general.descWhatDraggingWithTheLeft: What dragging with the left mouse button does on empty canvas. Pan canvas moves the view. Select nodes draws a selection box; pan with the right or middle mouse button (and two-finger scroll on a trackpad).
general.descWhenDrawingASelectionBox: When drawing a selection box: Full selects only nodes that are fully enclosed, Partial also selects intersecting nodes.

defModels.title: Default models
defModels.desc: Set default models for each type. These will auto-fill when you create new nodes.
defModels.codeHint: Writes Code Node code. Falls back to the chat model when unset.
defModels.removeBgHint: Fills Remove Background nodes. Falls back to the image model when unset.
defModels.upscaleHint: Fills Upscale nodes. Falls back to the image model when unset.

vaults.desc: A vault is a separate, isolated data store with its own database, assets, and RAG collections. Switch vaults to keep different sets of workflows and data apart. Switching restarts the backend and reloads the app.

storage.descAutosavesPer: Maximum recent autosaves kept for each workflow. Manual versions do not count toward this limit.
storage.descKeepDays: Autosaves older than this are removed even when the workflow is below its count limit.
storage.descKeepManual: Manual workflow snapshots older than this are removed. Checkpoints are always preserved.
storage.descKeepRuns: Completed, failed, and cancelled run records older than this are removed. Active runs are preserved.
storage.descKeepRunLogs: Per-node event logs from a run are removed after this many days. The run record itself follows the limit above.
storage.lblKeepRunTrace: Keep app run inputs and outputs (days)
storage.descKeepRunTrace: After this many days, inputs, outputs, and document snapshots expire. Status, timing, and cost remain until the completed run record expires.
storage.descKeepGen: After this many days, prompts, parameters, and logs are cleared from generation records. The billing record — model, provider, tokens, cost, and date — is kept.
storage.descAutoClean: Apply these limits in the background once per day. Database compaction remains manual.
storage.confirmCompactBody: Compaction returns unused SQLite pages to disk. It can pause database writes while it rebuilds a large local database.

FONT_PATH.label: Font Path
FONT_PATH.description: Location of font folder used by image processing nodes like RenderText. If not specified, the system will use default fonts.

BLENDER_PATH.label: Blender Path
BLENDER_PATH.description: Path to the Blender executable used by the nodetool.blender nodes. If not specified, the nodes look for blender on PATH and in the well-known install locations.

VECTORSTORE_DB_PATH.label: Vectorstore DB Path
VECTORSTORE_DB_PATH.description: Location of the sqlite-vec vector database file. Used to store and retrieve embeddings for semantic search and RAG applications.

USERS_FILE.label: Users File
USERS_FILE.description: Path to users.yaml file for multi-user bearer token authentication. Defaults to ~/.config/nodetool/users.yaml for local deployments.

TRANSFORMERS_JS_CACHE_DIR.label: Transformers JS Cache Dir
TRANSFORMERS_JS_CACHE_DIR.description: Cache directory for Transformers.js (@huggingface/transformers) model downloads. Defaults to <data-dir>/transformers-js-cache. This is separate from the Python HuggingFace Hub cache because the on-disk layout differs.

AUTOSAVE_ENABLED.label: Autosave Enabled
AUTOSAVE_ENABLED.description: Enable automatic saving of workflow versions (default: true)

AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_MINUTES.label: Autosave Interval Minutes
AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_MINUTES.description: Interval in minutes between automatic workflow autosaves (default: 5, range: 1-60)

AUTOSAVE_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS.label: Autosave Min Interval Seconds
AUTOSAVE_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Minimum interval in seconds between autosaves to prevent duplicates (default: 30)

AUTOSAVE_MAX_VERSIONS_PER_WORKFLOW.label: Autosave Max Versions Per Workflow
AUTOSAVE_MAX_VERSIONS_PER_WORKFLOW.description: Maximum number of autosave versions to keep per workflow (default: 20)

AUTOSAVE_KEEP_DAYS.label: Autosave Keep Days
AUTOSAVE_KEEP_DAYS.description: Number of days to keep autosave versions before cleanup (default: 7)

MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.label: Max Concurrent Jobs
MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.description: Maximum number of workflow runs a single client can execute at once (default: 4). Additional runs are queued and start automatically as running ones finish, preventing provider/API overload.

MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS_PER_WORKFLOW.label: Max Concurrent Runs Per Workflow
MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS_PER_WORKFLOW.description: Maximum number of concurrent runs of the same workflow before additional runs queue (default: 4). Only applies to runs that opt into concurrency (e.g. timeline/sketch generation); canvas runs always stay sequential per workflow. Also bounded by MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.

NODETOOL_AGENT_TURN_COST_CAP_USD.label: Nodetool Agent Turn Cost Cap Usd
NODETOOL_AGENT_TURN_COST_CAP_USD.description: Ceiling on provider spend for one agent run, in US dollars (default: 5.00). The whole run shares it: sub-agents, background subtasks, and agent nodes reserve against the same cap rather than opening their own. A turn whose worst case would cross it is refused before the call, and the run stops with a message naming the cap. Set it to 0 for no cap at all, which is what a local-only install wants — clearing the value restores the default instead, because an empty setting is indistinguishable from an unset one.

NODETOOL_AGENT_TURN_DEADLINE_MS.label: Nodetool Agent Turn Deadline Ms
NODETOOL_AGENT_TURN_DEADLINE_MS.description: Wall-clock bound on one agent run, in milliseconds (default: 1800000, i.e. 30 minutes). Checked before every model turn and every tool call, so a run that stalls on a slow provider ends instead of hanging.

NODETOOL_AGENT_MAX_CONCURRENCY.label: Nodetool Agent Max Concurrency
NODETOOL_AGENT_MAX_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum provider conversations an agent run may have open at once (default: 8). Shared by the whole run, so a fan-out of sub-agents inside a fan-out of steps cannot multiply into hundreds of simultaneous calls.

NODETOOL_AGENT_MAX_TURNS.label: Nodetool Agent Max Turns
NODETOOL_AGENT_MAX_TURNS.description: Maximum model turns an agent run may make in total (default: 200), counted across every loop it starts. This is the bound that still holds for a local model with no price, where the dollar cap cannot apply.

NODETOOL_AGENT_UNPRICED_TOKEN_CEILING.label: Nodetool Agent Unpriced Token Ceiling
NODETOOL_AGENT_UNPRICED_TOKEN_CEILING.description: Prompt-token ceiling for a turn on a model the price catalog does not cover (default: 400000). An unpriced model has no worst-case cost to reserve, so admitting it freely would make the dollar cap advisory; this bounds it by size instead. Such turns are counted as unpriced rather than as free spend.

NODETOOL_CHAT_COMPACTION_TOKENS.label: Nodetool Chat Compaction Tokens
NODETOOL_CHAT_COMPACTION_TOKENS.description: Estimated prompt size, in tokens, at which a chat turn summarizes the earlier part of its thread before calling the model (default: 120000). The estimate tokenizes the message text and tool calls and scores each attached image, audio, video or document at a fixed per-modality figure. It misses the tool definitions the same turn sends, so leave room under the model's context window rather than setting it close. A provider that holds the conversation itself (a resumed session, the Claude Agent SDK) is not measured this way; it compacts when it reports that the transcript no longer fits.

NODETOOL_CHAT_COMPACTION_KEEP_TURNS.label: Nodetool Chat Compaction Keep Turns
NODETOOL_CHAT_COMPACTION_KEEP_TURNS.description: How many of the most recent user turns a compaction leaves verbatim (default: 4). Everything before them becomes the summary. The cut always lands on a user message, so a tool call is never separated from its result.

NODETOOL_COMPACTION_MODEL.label: Nodetool Compaction Model
NODETOOL_COMPACTION_MODEL.description: Model that writes the compaction summary, as `provider/model` or a bare model id on the turn's own provider. Unset, the turn summarizes with the model it is already running. A summarizer that fails leaves the thread uncompacted and the turn runs against the full history.

VLLM_BASE_URL.label: vLLM Base URL
VLLM_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the vLLM OpenAI-compatible server (e.g., http://localhost:7777)

OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH.label: Ollama Context Length
OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH.description: Context window size (in tokens) for Ollama models. If not set, the provider will query the model for its default context length.

LLAMA_CPP_URL.label: Llama Cpp URL
LLAMA_CPP_URL.description: Base URL for the llama.cpp server (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:8080).

LLAMA_CPP_CONTEXT_LENGTH.label: Llama Cpp Context Length
LLAMA_CPP_CONTEXT_LENGTH.description: Context window size (in tokens) for llama.cpp models. Defaults to 128000.

NODE_LLAMA_CPP_MODELS_DIR.label: Node Llama Cpp Models Dir
NODE_LLAMA_CPP_MODELS_DIR.description: Directory containing local GGUF model files for in-process llama.cpp inference. Defaults to the platform llama.cpp cache directory.

NODE_LLAMA_CPP_GPU_BACKEND.label: Node Llama Cpp Gpu Backend
NODE_LLAMA_CPP_GPU_BACKEND.description: GPU backend for in-process llama.cpp inference. 'auto' lets node-llama-cpp detect the best backend.

LMSTUDIO_API_URL.label: Lmstudio API URL
LMSTUDIO_API_URL.description: Base URL for the LM Studio OpenAI-compatible server (e.g., http://localhost:1234)

NODE_SUPABASE_URL.label: Node Supabase URL
NODE_SUPABASE_URL.description: Supabase project URL used by user-provided nodes (separate from core SUPABASE_URL)

NODE_SUPABASE_SCHEMA.label: Node Supabase Schema
NODE_SUPABASE_SCHEMA.description: Optional schema for user/node Supabase tables (defaults to public when unset)

NODE_SUPABASE_TABLE_PREFIX.label: Node Supabase Table Prefix
NODE_SUPABASE_TABLE_PREFIX.description: Optional prefix applied to user/node Supabase tables to avoid clashes with core tables

TRACELOOP_APP_NAME.label: Traceloop App Name
TRACELOOP_APP_NAME.description: Override the OpenLLMetry application name (defaults to service name)

TRACELOOP_BASE_URL.label: Traceloop Base URL
TRACELOOP_BASE_URL.description: Override the Traceloop OTLP base URL

TRACELOOP_DISABLE_BATCH.label: Traceloop Disable Batch
TRACELOOP_DISABLE_BATCH.description: Disable Traceloop batch span processing for local development

SERP_PROVIDER.label: SERP Provider
SERP_PROVIDER.description: Select which search provider to use for web search operations.

ZAI_USE_CODING_PLAN.label: Zai Use Coding Plan
ZAI_USE_CODING_PLAN.description: Use Z.AI coding plan endpoint instead of normal endpoint

DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL.label: Dashscope Base URL
DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Model Studio keys are region-scoped; set this to your region's endpoint (default: https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1, the international/Singapore region)

KIE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.label: Kie Timeout Seconds
KIE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Global timeout in seconds for Kie.ai API calls (0 = use default per-model timeout)
